# Trash Company

> Trash Company (Trash Gen Consulting Private Limited) is an event waste management and bulk waste management company from Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. It runs zero-waste programmes for stadiums, marathons, conferences, festivals and weddings across Jaipur, Rajasthan and North India, and has delivered in Guwahati, Assam.

## What we do
- Event waste management: forecasting, bin and volunteer planning, on-ground segregation, collection, transport, composting and recycling, and a report by weight.
- Bulk waste management for stadiums, venues, hotels and campuses.
- Two-level segregation: wet and dry at source, then a hand sort into 16 material categories.
- Sustainability consulting: what materials to buy, how to set up segregation, vendor standards.
- Waste audits, impact reports and carbon programmes for events.

## Results, from our project reports
- Rajasthan Royals, IPL 2024: 73,317.8 kg collected over 7 home matches in Jaipur and Guwahati; 36,324 kg composted; 30,272.1 kg recycled or upcycled; 195,000+ fans guided.
- Rajasthan Royals, IPL 2025: 74,727.9 kg collected over 7 home matches (including construction and demolition waste); 64,045.6 kg composted, recycled or upcycled; 122,144+ fans guided.
- Rajasthan Royals, IPL 2026: 60,495.1 kg collected over 7 home matches; 29,078 kg composted; 24,424.1 kg recycled or upcycled (88.4%).
- Punjab Kings, IPL 2025: 18,449 kg collected over 2 matches at Sawai Mansingh Stadium, Jaipur.
- TiE Global Summit 2026, JECC Jaipur: 7,231 kg collected over 3 days; 94.4% composted, recycled or upcycled; 10,000+ attendees guided.
- AU Jaipur Marathon 2023: 161.1 kg audited and recycled, with Ecowrap.
- SHAPE South Asia 2024: end-to-end procurement consulting for zero-waste generation.
- Total: 234,382 kg of event waste collected and weighed.

## People
- Gaurav Sharma, Co-founder, CEO and Director. Known as the Trash Man of Rajasthan. Three-time TEDx speaker.
- Avi Aggarwal, Co-founder, COO and Director. World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2025 delegate.
